title: Question about Mallworld Bathrooms
content: Okay. So I am new here, forgive me. But. Here goes. Does anyone dream about being in a school, yours or one that you just know is a school, and go into the bathrooms. You go in, and the room iswayyyy too big? The room is filthy. All the toilets are disgusting, filled and none flush. There are people of all genders you don't really know milling about in the room, and they seem to try to keep you from finding a proper toilet? Or feel like they are trying to kick you out?
